title: Add goal loop continuation tests
objective: Prove how active goals continue, stop, and update state inside QueryLoop.
context: The natural insertion point is the no-tool-use branch after regular Stop hooks and before token-budget continuation.
This is where the project should adopt Claude's evaluator behavior while preserving existing Stop hook semantics.

source_evidence.note: No-tool-use branch runs Stop hooks and token-budget continuation.
Stop hooks already model block-as-user-message continuation.

include: Test unmet goal appends evaluator reason and continues.
Test met goal marks achieved and stops.
Test paused, blocked, cleared, and absent goals do not evaluate.
Test Stop hooks run before goal evaluation.
Test max turns still bounds continuation.
exclude: Do not alter Stop hook tests.

implementation_steps: Create loop/goal_continuation_test.go with fake provider and fake evaluator.
Use existing loop test helpers where possible.
Assert event order and state updates minimally.
Add failure expectation for missing loop config fields.
deliverables: Failing loop tests for automatic goal continuation.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert no infinite loop by using MaxTurns.
risks: Loop tests can become slow if they use real streaming paths.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing QueryLoop tests for automatic /goal continuation using a fake evaluator. Cover unmet, met, paused/cleared, Stop-hook ordering, and MaxTurns bounds. Do not implement loop changes.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the continuation message text stable but not verbose.
